domain: legislative process - bill-level ultimate-outcome prediction (Brazil, Chamber of Deputies)
prediction_question: A legislative proposition (Projeto de Lei, PEC, PLP, PDL, PRC, Requerimento and other documented types) is presented in the Brazilian Chamber of Deputies at a known date. At the presentation instant, given only presentation-time context - proposition type, the bill's own ementa (the abstract written at introduction), its author(s) and their party/faction, and the presentation calendar - will the proposition ultimately be transformed into legal norm (enacted) rather than archived or merged, by the close of its legislature?
prediction_time: The instant of presentation (dataApresentacao). Excluded from shipped features by documented timing reasoning: the publisher's indexação fields keywords and proposicoesTemas (assigned by the Chamber's indexing service after presentation - post-hoc, and the file documentation itself lists them beside 'informações sobre a tramitação mais recente'); all ultimoStatus_* fields (the current/last tramitação state - label source); regime as recorded in ultimoStatus (current regime, mutable after presentation); uriPropAnterior/Principal/Posterior (later-created links); urnFinal. Safe features: siglaTipo/codTipo/descricaoTipo, ementa text, dataApresentacao + calendar features, authors (from the separate proposicoesAutores bulk family), ano/numero.
target_definition: Binary from the publisher's own situation vocabulary in the bulk CSV's ultimoStatus (current status at the file vintage; file and live API agree, measured 2026-10-23): positive = situation code 1140 'Transformado em Norma Jurídica' (CORRECTED 2026-10-23: the discovery sample's 'idSituacao 251' was a positional indexing defect - column 25 is ultimoStatus_idTipoTramitacao, not idSituacao; the header-name-keyed parse shows 1140 with a consistent code->description table, e.g. 923 Arquivada, 1230 Transformado em nova proposição, 937 Vetado totalmente). Terminal negative = Arquivada* codes plus the other settled non-enactment states (Vetado totalmente, Retirado pelo(a) Autor(a), Devolvida ao(à) Autor(a), Tramitação Finalizada, Enviada ao Arquivo). Merged rows (1230 'Transformado em nova proposição') are EXCLUDED from the scored population - the outcome is carried by the merged-into bill (decision recorded; share measured per window). Rows with a non-terminal status, and the 25-53% of rows (by year, measured) whose idSituacao is empty - the API confirms genuinely no tramitação on record, not a file gap - are unobserved targets, excluded and counted per window, never membership decisions on future data. Label source columns: all ultimoStatus_* fields and urnFinal, excluded from shipped features.

sources.name: Bulk per-year proposition files (proposicoes)
sources.api: anonymous, semicolon-delimited UTF-8 CSV, byte-range supported; 30 documented columns (id, uri, siglaTipo, numero, ano, codTipo, descricaoTipo, ementa, ementaDetalhada, keywords, dataApresentacao, uriOrgaoNumerador, uriPropAnterior, uriPropPrincipal, uriPropPosterior, urlInteiroTeor, urnFinal, ultimoStatus_dataHora/sequencia/uriRelator/idOrgao/siglaOrgao/uriOrgao/regime/descricaoTramitacao/idTipoTramitacao/descricaoSituacao/idSituacao/despacho/apreciacao/url). Publisher description: 'cada registro contém dados sobre uma proposição apresentada à Câmara dos Deputados para deliberação ... informações sobre a tramitação mais recente'.
sources.license: see license_evidence (portal terms: domínio público with attribution)
sources.access: measured 2026-10-21: sizes 1991: 4,451,452 B; 1995: 4,914,946 B; 2000: 6,846,297 B; 2005: 22,247,788 B; 2010: 15,888,349 B; 2015: 34,171,659 B; 2019: 33,295,980 B (last-modified 2026-10-21, live); 2023: 52,259,953 B; 2024: 53,088,881 B; 2025: 90,204,760 B. FILE SEMANTICS MEASURED: 98-100% of rows in file-YYYY have dataApresentacao in year YYYY; the ~2% remainder are older bills re-numbered to the current 'ano' when un-archived at a legislature boundary (measured: 2019-file rows with dataApresentacao 2000/2001). Cohorts must therefore be defined by dataApresentacao across the union of files, not by file year alone.

sources.name: REST API v2 - proposicoes
sources.api: anonymous; dataApresentacaoInicio/dataApresentacaoFim cohort filter (range limited to 3 months per request - measured HTTP 400: 'A diferença entre as datas não pode ser maior que 3 meses'); itens=100 per page; the Link rel=last header gives page counts. license_evidence.note: Portal terms (fetched 2026-10-21): 'Todas as informações publicadas no Portal da Câmara são de domínio público, gratuitas e podem ser reproduzidas desde que citada a fonte "Câmara dos Deputados" e a autoria da informação, quando houver.' Free reproduction with attribution; the Dados Abertos portal is part of the Portal da Câmara.

Institutional open-data policy: Portaria nº 226 de 23/12/2025 defines dados abertos as 'dados processáveis por máquina, estruturados em formato aberto, referenciados na internet e disponibilizados ao público para livre utilização, consumo ou cruzamento' and provides for public disclosure of databases under arts. 29 a 37 da Lei nº 14.129, de 2021. LICENCE DECISION: redistribution of derived rows permitted with attribution ('Fonte: Câmara dos Deputados'); source terms preserved; our derived compilation dedicated CC0 per standing policy; derived, never presented as the Chamber's official product.

split_strategy: Cohorts by dataApresentacao over the union of the 35 year files (1991-2025; files processed descending, first id wins so re-numbered bills contribute their current row), windows by presentation date: train 1991-01..2014-12, eval 2015-01..2018-12, holdout 2019-01..2022-12. RIGHT-CENSORING CORRECTED 2026-10-23: Brazilian propositions carry across legislatures (bills presented 2019 still show live statuses with 2024-2026 timestamps, file and API agree), so 'closed legislature' does not settle labels; the scored population is bills whose status is terminal at the current file vintage, and the unobserved share (no-status + non-terminal) is measured per window and recorded as a property - it rises with recency. Sampled positive rates drift strongly downward by cohort (1991 whole file 311/4,436 = 7.0%; 2005 sampled ~2.2%; 2019-2022 sampled ~0.4-0.8%), a measured phenomenon property. Grain: one proposition = one row, keyed by id (unique across the union; construction asserts uniqueness).

measurements.ranged_samples_2026_10_21: probe_samples.py: 4 x 1 MB ranged chunks each of proposicoes-2005.csv (4,852 parsed rows) and proposicoes-2019.csv (4,909 rows). 2005 sample: dataApresentacao 100% in 2005; ultimoStatus vocabulary: 'Arquivada' ~62% across codes (1005, 502, 241, 100, 1001, 180...), 'Transformado em nova proposição' ~3.5% (codes 469, 604...), 'Transformado em Norma Jurídica' (idSituacao 251) 72 = 1.5%; urnFinal non-empty 0/4,852. 2019 sample: 98% presented 2019; statuses still mixed (Arquivada 14.8%, ongoing tramitação states) - recent cohorts right-censored, excluded from the task.
measurements.situation_code_quality_2026_10_21: Many rows carry idSituacao with EMPTY descricaoSituacao (codes '100', '319' are the most frequent with empty descriptions, 39-40% of sample rows) while the same codes also appear WITH descriptions elsewhere - the label must be defined on the publisher's situation CODE table (fetched at construction), with descriptions as a cross-check where present. Measured on the same samples.
measurements.api_cohort_counts_2026_10_21: dataApresentacao-filtered cohorts via Link rel=last page counts x 100: 2005 ~= 26,300 (41+92+61+69 pages); 2019 ~= 41,400 (68+105+107+135). Cross-checks the file-based row estimate for 2005 (~22 MB / ~850 B/row).
measurements.cost_measured: Discovery cost: 15 requests / ~4 MB of ranged samples / 31 s wall clock (probe_samples.py) + 8 API count requests. Construction cost: ~35 year files (sizes measured, sum ~= 1.2 GB ESTIMATE) + proposicoesAutores files; worker-trivial.
measurements.construction_probes_2026_10_23: probe_censoring.py (v1, naive line-splitting: defective - quoted multi-line ementas corrupt mid-file chunks), corrected by probe_censoring2.py (quote-parity record-boundary trimming; whole-1991 file ground truth) + probe_empty_status.py + probe_file_vs_api.py + probe_file_inventory.py, all run end-to-end 2026-10-23 from the coordinator: (1) situation-code vocabulary keyed by header name: 923 Arquivada (2,491 of 4,436 whole-1991 rows), 1140 Transformado em Norma Jurídica (311 = 7.0%), 1230 Transformado em nova proposição, 937 Vetado totalmente, 925 Tramitando em Conjunto, 907/915/924/926/936/1070/1120/1170/1220/1285 ongoing/other - consistent code->description pairs, unlike the discovery sample's mis-indexed columns; (2) empty ultimoStatus share by year-file sample: 1991 36.6% (whole file), 2000 14.8%, 2005 51.4%, 2010 52.7%, 2015 51.9%, 2019 48.7%, 2021 52.3%, 2022 39.9% - and the API returns statusProposicao None for sampled such ids, so the emptiness is the publisher's own record, not a file gap; empty-status rows skew to procedural types (RIC/REQ/EMP/MSC) but include some PLs; (3) right-censoring: bills presented 2019 still carry non-terminal statuses with ultimoStatus_dataHora in 2024-2026 (e.g. PL 1/2019 id 2190407 'Aguardando Apreciação pelo Senado Federal', dataHora 2025-08-26) and the API agrees with the file on every sampled id - the vintage is current, the legislatures are not closed for these bills; (4) file inventory: 35/35 years 200 OK for both families, proposicoes 747.4 MB + proposicoesAutores 456.0 MB total; (5) autores schema measured: idProposicao, tipoAutor, siglaPartidoAutor, siglaUFAutor, ordemAssinatura, proponente - first-author features keyed on the proponente row. Observation for the novelty record: an HF org (belisards) mirrors the raw proposicoes files 1934-2024 (ementas_camarabr_1934_2024) - raw extract, no splits, no scored contract; recorded as a mirror observation, not permission, and it does not change the recorded 'differentiated' verdict.
measurements.camara_001_full_union_2026_10_23: Full build over the 70 bulk year files on the worker (camara-001, 395.6 s, exit 2 on guard anchors only). Measured: 642,067 in-window bills (presented 1991-2022) after a descending-first-wins union; splits train 160,559 rows / 14,323 positives (8.92%), eval 37,885 / 1,397 (3.69%), holdout 36,892 / 1,793 (4.86%); assumption buckets - train empty-status 208,487 / non-terminal 9,662 / merged 12,893, eval 68,809 / 8,553 / 776, holdout 75,639 / 20,842 / 1,070. Two measured properties to report beside any model score: (1) the scored population is only the terminal-status subset - roughly 55% of train and 64% of holdout rows are unobserved (no status or still live), so the task is conditioned on an observed fate and the unobserved share rises with recency; (2) positive rate moves 8.92% (train) -> 3.69% (eval) -> 4.86% (holdout), a prevalence shift that is a property of the phenomenon, not a construction fault. The in-build naive references and the fixture results are in the camara-002 summary.

prior_art: LegisPL-BR dataset (GitHub, PL 2022-2024, raw extract, no splits/scoring); ML analise de projetos legislativos ZFM 2011-2018 (regressao logistica, paper); SBSI 5085 (approval prediction, paper); LLM constitucionalidade study (194-bill curated sample, paper)
novelty_check.theirs: Publisher ships raw per-year bulk files and the API, no task. Research prior art: a 2011-2018 logistic-regression study of ZFM-related bills becoming norma juridica (semanticscholar 2d57/06f0a54a); SBSI 5085 'Compreendendo e Prevendo o Processo Legislativo na Camara' (approval prediction model, paper only); LegisPL-BR (github.com/juanmorysson/LegisPL-BR) - a published GitHub dataset of PL propositions 2022-2024 with numero, ano, autores, ementa, ultima tramitacao, no splits, no scored contract, and covering only the current (unclosed) legislature so final-outcome labels are right-censored; that slice cannot carry a settled-outcome prediction task.
novelty_check.ours: First scored, temporally-split formulation of bill advancement for the Brazilian Camara dos Deputados over the full 1991-2022 closed-legislature panel (all proposition types, ~26k-41k presentations/year, label = ultimate outcome from the publisher's own situation vocabulary, e.g. idSituacao 251 'Transformado em Norma Juridica', measured 1.5% on the 2005 cohort sample), with presentation-time features only (type, ementa text, author/party, presentation calendar; the publisher's post-hoc indexacao fields keywords/temas excluded by documented timing reasoning), disjoint train/eval/holdout windows by presentation date, and a runner-compatible binary contract.
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
